patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I doubled the weights, skipped the water, and at two in the morning my calf turned into a fist. It's better now but it frightened the life out of me.
presentation.triageNote: 44-year-old female with a self-limiting night-time calf cramp after unaccustomed exercise; the calf is soft and non-tender with no swelling or asymmetry.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because the fully resolved exercise-associated cramp has no swelling, tenderness, or asymmetry and requires no counted resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a benign transient calf cramp without findings of thrombosis or injury.
clinical.acuityReason: The fully resolved exercise-associated cramp has no swelling, tenderness, or asymmetry and requires no counted resource.
teachingPoints: The job here is excluding DVT: no swelling, no tenderness, no calf asymmetry, and it resolved completely. Compare with case 076, which has all of those findings.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Hydration and stretching guidance with return precautions would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 44-year-old woman in workout clothes, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting with one leg extended, absently rubbing her calf
signs: a hand rubbing the back of one calf
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 44-year-old woman in workout clothes, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with one leg extended, absently rubbing her calf. Expression: slightly embarrassed, entirely comfortable now. Clearly visible: a hand rubbing the back of one calf; workout clothes and trainers. Overall: entirely well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
